description: The specified recursion satisfies \(F(\bar x,0)=g(\bar x)\) and \(F(\bar x,n+1)=h(\bar x,n,F(\bar x,n))\), with the index after the parameter tuple.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.lastRec_equations {n : ℕ}
  (g : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.Args n → ℕ)
  (h : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.Args (n + 2) → ℕ)
  (x : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.Args n) (i : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.lastRec g h (x ++ 0 ::ᵥ List.Vector.nil) = g x ∧
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.lastRec g h (x ++ (i + 1) ::ᵥ List.Vector.nil) =
      h
        (x ++
          i ::ᵥ
            Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.lastRec g h (x ++ i ::ᵥ List.Vector.nil) ::ᵥ
              List.Vector.nil)
